verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַתָּ֣ה תִרְאֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֽ͏ֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לְפַרְעֹ֑ה כִּ֣י בְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ יְשַׁלְּחֵ֔ם וּבְיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֔ה יְגָרְשֵׁ֖ם מֵאַרְצֹֽו׃ ס
verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِمُوسَى: «ٱلْآنَ تَنْظُرُ مَا أَنَا أَفْعَلُ بِفِرْعَوْنَ. فَإِنَّهُ بِيَدٍ قَوِيَّةٍ يُطْلِقُهُمْ، وَبِيَدٍ قَوِيَّةٍ يَطْرُدُهُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِهِ».
verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses: 'Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh; for by a strong hand shall he let them go, and by a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.'
verses.kjv: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّمَ ٱللهُ مُوسَى وَقَالَ لَهُ: «أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.en: And God spoke unto Moses, and said unto him: 'I am the LORD;
verses.kjv: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I [am] the LORD:
verses.web: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am Yahweh.

verses.he: וָאֵרָ֗א אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶל־יִצְחָ֥ק וְאֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּאֵ֣ל שַׁדָּ֑י וּשְׁמִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א נֹודַ֖עְתִּי לָהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: وَأَنَا ظَهَرْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ بِأَنِّي ٱلْإِلَهُ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ. وَأَمَّا بِٱسْمِي «يَهْوَهْ» فَلَمْ أُعْرَفْ عِنْدَهُمْ.
verses.en: and I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, as God Almighty, but by My name Jehovah I made Me not known to them.
verses.kjv: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by [the name of] God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
verses.web: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.

verses.he: וְגַ֨ם הֲקִמֹ֤תִי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי֙ אִתָּ֔ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֵ֛ת אֶ֥רֶץ מְגֻרֵיהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־גָּ֥רוּ בָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: وَأَيْضًا أَقَمْتُ مَعَهُمْ عَهْدِي: أَنْ أُعْطِيَهُمْ أَرْضَ كَنْعَانَ أَرْضَ غُرْبَتِهِمِ ٱلَّتِي تَغَرَّبُوا فِيهَا.
verses.en: And I have also established My covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their sojournings, wherein they sojourned.
verses.kjv: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
verses.web: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.

verses.he: וְגַ֣ם ׀ אֲנִ֣י שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי אֶֽת־נַאֲקַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִצְרַ֖יִם מַעֲבִדִ֣ים אֹתָ֑ם וָאֶזְכֹּ֖ר אֶת־בְּרִיתִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَأَنَا أَيْضًا قَدْ سَمِعْتُ أَنِينَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَعْبِدُهُمُ ٱلْمِصْرِيُّونَ، وَتَذَكَّرْتُ عَهْدِي.
verses.en: And moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered My covenant.
verses.kjv: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.web: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.

verses.he: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֥ר לִבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ וְהֹוצֵאתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֗ם מִתַּ֙חַת֙ סִבְלֹ֣ת מִצְרַ֔יִם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵעֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וְגָאַלְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ בִּזְרֹ֣ועַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבִשְׁפָטִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים׃
verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ قُلْ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ. وَأَنَا أُخْرِجُكُمْ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَثْقَالِ ٱلْمِصْرِيِّينَ وَأُنْقِذُكُمْ مِنْ عُبُودِيَّتِهِمْ وَأُخَلِّصُكُمْ بِذِرَاعٍ مَمْدُودَةٍ وَبِأَحْكَامٍ عَظِيمَةٍ،
verses.en: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel: I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will deliver you from their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments;
verses.kjv: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I [am] the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
verses.web: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.

verses.he: וְלָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֥ם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וִֽידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם הַמֹּוצִ֣יא אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת סִבְלֹ֥ות מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.ar: وَأَتَّخِذُكُمْ لِي شَعْبًا، وَأَكُونُ لَكُمْ إِلَهًا. فَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُخْرِجُكُمْ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَثْقَالِ ٱلْمِصْرِيِّينَ.
verses.en: and I will take you to Me for a people, and I will be to you a God; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.kjv: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.web: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

verses.he: וְהֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־יָדִ֔י לָתֵ֣ת אֹתָ֔הּ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֹתָ֥הּ לָכֶ֛ם מֹורָשָׁ֖ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَأُدْخِلُكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي رَفَعْتُ يَدِي أَنْ أُعْطِيَهَا لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ. وَأُعْطِيَكُمْ إِيَّاهَا مِيرَاثًا. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ».
verses.en: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning which I lifted up My hand to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for a heritage: I am the LORD.'
verses.kjv: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am Yahweh.’”

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֛ה כֵּ֖ן אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִקֹּ֣צֶר ר֔וּחַ וּמֵעֲבֹדָ֖ה קָשָֽׁה׃ פ
verses.ar: فَكَلَّمَ مُوسَى هَكَذَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، وَلَكِنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعُوا لِمُوسَى مِنْ صِغَرِ ٱلنَّفْسِ، وَمِنَ ٱلْعُبُودِيَّةِ ٱلْقَاسِيَةِ.
verses.en: And Moses spoke so unto the children of Israel; but they hearkened not unto Moses for impatience of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
verses.web: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: בֹּ֣א דַבֵּ֔ר אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וִֽישַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאַרְצֹֽו׃
verses.ar: «اُدْخُلْ قُلْ لِفِرْعَوْنَ مَلِكِ مِصْرَ أَنْ يُطْلِقَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ أَرْضِهِ».
verses.en: 'Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.'
verses.kjv: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.web: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֤ן בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹֽא־שָׁמְע֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וְאֵיךְ֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣נִי פַרְעֹ֔ה וַאֲנִ֖י עֲרַ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽיִם׃ פ
verses.ar: فَتَكَلَّمَ مُوسَى أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ قَائِلًا: «هُوَذَا بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ لَمْ يَسْمَعُوا لِي، فَكَيْفَ يَسْمَعُنِي فِرْعَوْنُ وَأَنَا أَغْلَفُ ٱلشَّفَتَيْنِ؟»
verses.en: And Moses spoke before the LORD, saying: 'Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?'
verses.kjv: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who [am] of uncircumcised lips?
verses.web: Moses spoke before Yahweh, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֒ וַיְצַוֵּם֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶל־פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְהֹוצִ֥יא אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ ס
verses.ar: فَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ، وَأَوْصَى مَعَهُمَا إِلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَإِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ مَلِكِ مِصْرَ فِي إِخْرَاجِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ.
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

verses.he: אֵ֖לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֣י בֵית־אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל חֲנֹ֤וךְ וּפַלּוּא֙ חֶצְרֹ֣ון וְכַרְמִ֔י אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת רְאוּבֵֽן׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ رُؤَسَاءُ بُيُوتِ آبَائِهِمْ: بَنُو رَأُوبَيْنَ بِكْرِ إِسْرَائِيلَ: حَنُوكُ وَفَلُّو وَحَصْرُونُ وَكَرْمِي. هَذِهِ عَشَائِرُ رَأُوبَيْنَ.
verses.en: These are the heads of their fathers' houses: the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. These are the families of Reuben.
verses.kjv: ¶ These [be] the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these [be] the families of Reuben.
verses.web: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעֹ֗ון יְמוּאֵ֨ל וְיָמִ֤ין וְאֹ֙הַד֙ וְיָכִ֣ין וְצֹ֔חַר וְשָׁא֖וּל בֶּן־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑ית אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת שִׁמְעֹֽון׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو شِمْعُونَ: يَمُوئِيلُ وَيَامِينُ وَأُوهَدُ وَيَاكِينُ وَصُوحَرُ وَشَأُولُ ٱبْنُ ٱلْكَنْعَانِيَّةِ. هَذِهِ عَشَائِرُ شِمْعُونَ.
verses.en: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman. These are the families of Simeon.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these [are] the families of Simeon.
verses.web: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.

verses.he: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שְׁמֹ֤ות בְּנֵֽי־לֵוִי֙ לְתֹ֣לְדֹתָ֔ם גֵּרְשֹׁ֕ון וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִ֑י וּשְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י לֵוִ֔י שֶׁ֧בַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ أَسْمَاءُ بَنِي لَاوِي بِحَسَبِ مَوَالِيدِهِمْ: جِرْشُونُ وَقَهَاتُ وَمَرَارِي. وَكَانَتْ سِنُو حَيَاةِ لَاوِي مِئَةً وَسَبْعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً.
verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon and Kohath, and Merari. And the years of the life of Levi were a hundred thirty and seven years.
verses.kjv: ¶ And these [are] the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi [were] an hundred thirty and seven years.
verses.web: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.

verses.he: בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשֹׁ֛ון לִבְנִ֥י וְשִׁמְעִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: اِبْنَا جِرْشُونَ: لِبْنِي وَشِمْعِي بِحَسَبِ عَشَائِرِهِمَا.
verses.en: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
verses.kjv: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
verses.web: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י קְהָ֔ת עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר וְחֶבְרֹ֖ון וְעֻזִּיאֵ֑ל וּשְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י קְהָ֔ת שָׁלֹ֧שׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو قَهَاتَ: عَمْرَامُ وَيِصْهَارُ وَحَبْرُونُ وَعُزِّيئِيلُ. وَكَانَتْ سِنُو حَيَاةِ قَهَاتَ مِئَةً وَثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً.
verses.en: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel. And the years of the life of Kohath were a hundred thirty and three years.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath [were] an hundred thirty and three years.
verses.web: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י לְתֹלְדֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَٱبْنَا مَرَارِي: مَحْلِي وَمُوشِي. هَذِهِ عَشَائِرُ ٱللَّاوِيِّينَ بِحَسَبِ مَوَالِيدِهِمْ.
verses.en: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these [are] the families of Levi according to their generations.
verses.web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.

verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֨ח עַמְרָ֜ם אֶת־יֹוכֶ֤בֶד דֹּֽדָתֹו֙ לֹ֣ו לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד לֹ֔ו אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וּשְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י עַמְרָ֔ם שֶׁ֧בַע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَأَخَذَ عَمْرَامُ يُوكَابَدَ عَمَّتَهُ زَوْجَةً لَهُ. فَوَلَدَتْ لَهُ هَارُونَ وَمُوسَى. وَكَانَتْ سِنُو حَيَاةِ عَمْرَامَ مِئَةً وَسَبْعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً.
verses.en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. And the years of the life of Amram were a hundred and thirty and seven years.
verses.kjv: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram [were] an hundred and thirty and seven years.
verses.web: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֖י יִצְהָ֑ר קֹ֥רַח וָנֶ֖פֶג וְזִכְרִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو يِصْهَارَ: قُورَحُ وَنَافَجُ وَذِكْرِي.
verses.en: And the sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.web: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל מִֽישָׁאֵ֥ל וְאֶלְצָפָ֖ן וְסִתְרִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو عُزِّيئِيلَ: مِيشَائِيلُ وَأَلْصَافَانُ وَسِتْرِي.
verses.en: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Sithri.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
verses.web: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־אֱלִישֶׁ֧בַע בַּת־עַמִּינָדָ֛ב אֲחֹ֥ות נַחְשֹׁ֖ון לֹ֣ו לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד לֹ֗ו אֶת־נָדָב֙ וְאֶת־אֲבִיה֔וּא אֶת־אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאֶת־אִֽיתָמָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَأَخَذَ هَارُونُ أَلِيشَابَعَ بِنْتَ عَمِّينَادَابَ أُخْتَ نَحْشُونَ زَوْجَةً لَهُ، فَوَلَدَتْ لَهُ نَادَابَ وَأَبِيهُوَ وَأَلِعَازَارَ وَإِيثَامَارَ.
verses.en: And Aaron took him Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, to wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.kjv: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.web: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.he: וּבְנֵ֣י קֹ֔רַח אַסִּ֥יר וְאֶלְקָנָ֖ה וַאֲבִיאָסָ֑ף אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקָּרְחִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَبَنُو قُورَحَ: أَسِّيرُ وَأَلْقَانَةُ وَأَبِيَأَسَافُ. هَذِهِ عَشَائِرُ ٱلْقُورَحِيِّينَ.
verses.en: And the sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these [are] the families of the Korhites.
verses.web: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.

verses.he: וְאֶלְעָזָ֨ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֜ן לָקַֽח־לֹ֨ו מִבְּנֹ֤ות פּֽוּטִיאֵל֙ לֹ֣ו לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֹ֖ו אֶת־פִּֽינְחָ֑ס אֵ֗לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲבֹ֥ות הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَأَلِعَازَارُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَخَذَ لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْ بَنَاتِ فُوطِيئِيلَ زَوْجَةً، فَوَلَدَتْ لَهُ فِينَحَاسَ. هَؤُلَاءِ هُمْ رُؤَسَاءُ آبَاءِ ٱللَّاوِيِّينَ بِحَسَبِ عَشَائِرِهِمْ.
verses.en: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites according to their families.
verses.kjv: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him [one] of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these [are] the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
verses.web: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.

verses.he: ה֥וּא אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם הֹוצִ֜יאוּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל־צִבְאֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: هَذَانِ هُمَا هَارُونُ وَمُوسَى ٱللَّذَانِ قَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لَهُمَا: «أَخْرِجَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ» بِحَسَبِ أَجْنَادِهِمْ.
verses.en: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said: 'Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their hosts.'
verses.kjv: These [are] that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
verses.web: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom Yahweh said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”

verses.he: הֵ֗ם הַֽמְדַבְּרִים֙ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֔יִם לְהֹוצִ֥יא אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם ה֥וּא מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.ar: هُمَا ٱللَّذَانِ كَلَّمَا فِرْعَوْنَ مَلِكَ مِصْرَ فِي إِخْرَاجِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ مِصْرَ. هَذَانِ هُمَا مُوسَى وَهَارُونُ.
verses.en: These are they that spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.
verses.kjv: These [are] they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these [are] that Moses and Aaron.
verses.web: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֗י בְּיֹ֨ום דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ פ
verses.ar: وَكَانَ يَوْمَ كَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى فِي أَرْضِ مِصْرَ
verses.en: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spoke unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.kjv: ¶ And it came to pass on the day [when] the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.web: On the day when Yahweh spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דַּבֵּ֗ר אֶל־פַּרְעֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ كَلَّمَهُ قَائِلًا: «أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ. كَلِّمْ فِرْعَوْنَ مَلِكَ مِصْرَ بِكُلِّ مَا أَنَا أُكَلِّمُكَ بِهِ».
verses.en: that the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying: 'I am the LORD; speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I speak unto thee.'
verses.kjv: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I [am] the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הֵ֤ן אֲנִי֙ עֲרַ֣ל שְׂפָתַ֔יִם וְאֵ֕יךְ יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵלַ֖י פַּרְעֹֽה׃ פ
verses.ar: فَقَالَ مُوسَى أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ: «هَا أَنَا أَغْلَفُ ٱلشَّفَتَيْنِ. فَكَيْفَ يَسْمَعُ لِي فِرْعَوْنُ؟».
verses.en: And Moses said before the LORD: 'Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?'
verses.kjv: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I [am] of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
verses.web: Moses said before Yahweh, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”
